description_en: Stops a running task flow instance
description_zh: 调用StopTaskFlowInstance接口，停止运行中的任务流实例
name: StopTaskFlowInstance

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html

租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html

parameters.help_en: The task flow ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
